exposure: presence of > 1 fetal heartbeat at 6 weeks' gestation
cohort: 8,948 women who underwent assisted reproductive technology (ART) and gave birth in Massachusetts
finding: Plurality is the predominant ART treatment risk factor associated with substantial excess morbidity for both mother and infants.
mod_finding: This study found that women who underwent ART treatment and had twin pregnancies had a significantly higher risk of primary cesarean section compared to those who had singleton pregnancies.
